title: In silico prediction of natural compounds as potential multi-target inhibitors of structural proteins of SARS-CoV-2.
authors: Rani, Jyoti; Bhargav, Anasuya; Khan, Faez Iqbal; Ramachandran, Srinivasan; Lai, Dakun; Bajpai, Urmi
one_liner_zh: 该文用计算对接预测天然化合物对SARS-CoV-2结构蛋白的多靶点抑制，对象为病毒蛋白-小分子互作，非蛋白质-DNA体系，且无AI或MD方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: The severe acute respiratory syndrome coronavirus 2 (SARS-CoV-2) has caused a colossal loss to human health and lives and has deeply impacted socio-economic growth. Remarkable efforts have been made by the scientific community in containing the virus by successful development of vaccines and diagnostic kits. Initiatives towards drug repurposing and discovery have also been undertaken. In this study, we compiled the known natural anti-viral compounds using text mining of the literature and examined them against four major structural proteins of SARS-CoV-2, namely, spike (S) protein, nucleocapsid (N) protein, membrane (M) protein and envelope (E) protein. Following computational approaches, we identified fangchinoline and versicolactone C as the compounds to exhibit strong binding to the target proteins and causing structural deformation of three structural proteins (N, S and M). We recommend the inhibitory effects of these compounds from our study should be experimentally validated against SARS-CoV-2.Communicated by Ramaswamy H. Sarma.
abstract_zh: 严重急性呼吸综合征冠状病毒2（SARS-CoV-2）对人类健康与生命造成了巨大损失，并深刻影响了社会经济增长。科学界通过成功开发疫苗和诊断试剂盒，在遏制病毒方面做出了显著努力。同时，也开展了药物再利用和发现的举措。在本研究中，我们利用文献文本挖掘汇编了已知的天然抗病毒化合物，并针对SARS-CoV-2的四种主要结构蛋白，即刺突（S）蛋白、核衣壳（N）蛋白、膜（M）蛋白和包膜（E）蛋白进行了检测。通过计算方法，我们鉴定出防己诺林碱（fangchinoline）和versicolactone C为与靶蛋白强结合并导致三种结构蛋白（N、S和M）结构变形的化合物。我们建议，本研究中这些化合物的抑制效果应通过实验验证其对SARS-CoV-2的作用。由Ramaswamy H. Sarma通讯。
